id: cuad:VAPOTHERM, INC. - Manufacturing and Supply Agreement

findings.quoted_text: Medica shall use [* * *] efforts to develop technical know-how that would permit them to manufacture the Cartridge less expensively and shall no less than semiannually furnish the Joint Review Committee with a detailed report as to their progress in this area.

by Vapotherm, if for any reason other than an Event of Force Majeure Medica fails to deliver within [* * *] days after the required delivery date, or on more than two occasions in any [* * *]-day period fails to deliver within [* * *] days after the required delivery day, any shipment of Cartridge it is required to deliver pursuant to Section 3.2, Section 4.2, or Section 9.3

On delivery by Medica of a shipment of Cartridges in accordance with Section 3.3, Medica shall issue to Vapotherm an invoice for that shipment stating a price consistent with the terms of this Agreement. Vapotherm shall pay each such invoice in full within [* * *] Calendar Days from the date of invoice, unless Vapotherm has rejected the shipment in question in accordance with Section 4.2.

Medica shall use [* * *] efforts to develop technical know-how that would permit them to manufacture the Cartridge less expensively and shall no less than semiannually furnish the Joint Review Committee with a detailed report as to their progress in this area.
findings.explanation: This imposes an ongoing obligation on Medica to research and develop cost-saving manufacturing improvements and report detailed proprietary know-how semi-annually without guaranteed compensation or assurance of retaining the financial upside.
findings.suggested_change: Limit cost-reduction R&D obligations to commercially reasonable efforts and ensure that proprietary manufacturing innovations remain Medica's exclusive intellectual property without forcing automatic price reductions.

findings.quoted_text: by Vapotherm, if for any reason other than an Event of Force Majeure Medica fails to deliver within [* * *] days after the required delivery date, or on more than two occasions in any [* * *]-day period fails to deliver within [* * *] days after the required delivery day, any shipment of Cartridge it is required to deliver pursuant to Section 3.2, Section 4.2, or Section 9.3
findings.explanation: Gives Vapotherm the unilateral right to terminate the entire agreement immediately for minor or repeated slight delivery delays, without providing Medica adequate cure periods.
findings.suggested_change: Add a formal cure period for delivery delays before termination rights vest, and ensure reciprocal termination rights for Vapotherm's defaults.

findings.quoted_text: On delivery by Medica of a shipment of Cartridges in accordance with Section 3.3, Medica shall issue to Vapotherm an invoice for that shipment stating a price consistent with the terms of this Agreement. Vapotherm shall pay each such invoice in full within [* * *] Calendar Days from the date of invoice, unless Vapotherm has rejected the shipment in question in accordance with Section 4.2.
findings.explanation: If the payment window is lengthy and payment is conditioned on delivery without advance deposits, Medica bears an excessive working capital burden for manufacturing safety stock and raw materials.
findings.suggested_change: Negotiate a shorter payment period and require an upfront deposit or milestone payments for safety stock inventory.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I hope you are well. Before we move forward, I would like to propose a few adjustments to the agreement. - Regarding the relevant clause, the agreement imposes ongoing obligations to research and develop cost-saving manufacturing improvements and report detailed proprietary know-how semi-annually without guaranteed compensation, and I propose limiting these cost-reduction R&D obligations to commercially reasonable efforts while ensuring that proprietary manufacturing innovations remain exclusive. - In the relevant clause, the agreement gives unilateral termination rights immediately for minor or repeated slight delivery delays without adequate cure periods, and I propose adding a formal cure period for delivery delays before termination rights vest along with reciprocal termination rights. - Under the relevant clause, the payment window is lengthy and payment is conditioned on delivery without advance deposits, creating an excessive working capital burden, and I propose negotiating a shorter payment period and requiring an upfront deposit or milestone payments for safety stock inventory. Thank you for your time and consideration.
